title: Price the chain per verified buyer, and measure each field's fill rate first
hypothesis: Professional posts were worth adding to every row.
change: Measured fill rate and cost per field on the 3 proof rows, then priced the end-to-end chain per verified buyer.

oracle.baseline: posts field: 2.5 credits each, 1 of 3 filled

result: People search filled 1 of 3, professional posts 1 of 3 at 2.5 credits each, Findymail plus ZeroBounce 2 of 2 at 0.6. The chain cost 1.1 credits per clean pick, up to about 1.6 with a fallback or retry.
next_decision: Drop fields under 60% fill from the default chain; report cost per verified buyer, not per row.
check: Before adding a paid field to a table, measure its fill rate on 3 to 5 rows and price it per verified result.
